body_en: Hi, my order #SN-448812 says delivered but I never got it. Email is maria.g@example.com. Can you help?
summary: Customer reports order SN-448812 marked delivered but not received.
reference_reply: Hi Maria, sorry your order SN-448812 hasn't arrived. Please check around your property and with neighbors; if it doesn't turn up within 48 hours of the delivery scan, reply here and we'll open a lost-package claim and reship it at no cost.

body_en: Love the new headphones, fastest delivery ever. Thanks team!
summary: Customer is happy with their headphones and the fast delivery.
reference_reply: Thank you so much for the kind words! We're thrilled the headphones arrived quickly and that you're enjoying them.

summary: Customer received a broken lamp (order SN-551203) and wants a replacement.

reference_reply_translated: Lamentamos que la lámpara de su pedido SN-551203 haya llegado dañada. Le enviaremos un reemplazo de inmediato; por favor responda con una foto del daño para procesarlo hoy.

body_en: This is the THIRD time I'm contacting you about my $1,240 laptop refund. If this isn't resolved by Friday my attorney will be in touch.

reference_reply: I'm sorry this has taken so long. I've escalated your refund for order SN-390017 to a specialist who will contact you within one business day with a resolution.
